races.paceDynamic: Mesaafi will dictate from the front with minimal early pressure in this small field. The prominent runners HK Fourteen, Diomed Duke and Solar Edge will track close behind, while the hold-up brigade of The Thames Boatman, Moulin Booj, Wheels Of Fire and Cressida Wildes will need to overcome a tactical disadvantage. With only eight runners over 5f at Windsor, Mesaafi can control fractions and kick clear, making life difficult for closers who rely on strong early pace. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mesaafi Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Mesaafi gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can kick clear turning for home with the prominent trackers best placed to respond. Hold-up horses face an impossible task with insufficient early pace to close into.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners HK Fourteen and Solar Edge press Mesaafi from the start
scenarios.body: A stronger early gallop develops with the front three pulling clear of the field. The enhanced pace gives hold-up horses a better target but the leaders may still prove too strong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected and Mesaafi goes too fast
scenarios.body: The front runners come back to the field in the final furlong creating opportunities for closers. The Thames Boatman and Wheels Of Fire can use their finishing kicks to best effect.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses contest the early lead creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: A muddling pace favours nothing in particular with the race becoming a pure speed test. Any horse with tactical speed and a good draw can capitalise on the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: The Untamed and Comical Point will ensure a genuine gallop from the gates, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. Their battle should create an honest tempo that prevents the race becoming a sprint finish. The strong pace will set up the race for horses with tactical speed who can position prominently without needing the lead. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners and those with proven tactical pace, while making life difficult for confirmed hold-up horses who rely on a slow-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Gallop Benefits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If The Untamed and Comical Point engage early and maintain a solid tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The genuine pace allows prominent runners to get into ideal positions without being exposed too early, suiting horses who can track the pace and quicken. This tempo negates the hold-up horses who need a messy, slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the two pace-setters go too hard early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up a closing finish for horses with tactical speed positioned in behind the leaders. Those who can sit handy without being on the pace benefit most from this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: One Pace Setter Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either The Untamed or Comical Point gets uncontested lead while the other is restrained
scenarios.body: The lone leader dictates terms and potentially gets away with softer fractions, making it harder for closers to peg back. Early pace advantage becomes decisive in this smaller field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners are held up creating a slowly-run race with multiple pace angles
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a sprint finish that suits horses with the best finishing kick from any position. This chaotic tempo favours pure speed over positioning.

races.paceDynamic: Regally Blonde will lead with Dogged and Just Adair prominent early, but none are habitual tearaways so the pace will be manageable rather than fierce. The large field of hold-up horses (Moon Over The Sea, Guinness Lad, Gert Lush, Stintino Sunset, Graffiti, Lynda's Dream, Scammer) will create a wall of runners tracking the leaders through the middle stages. Over this extended 1m3½f trip on good to firm going, the race will develop into a cavalry charge from the back as stamina kicks in. This pace shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can finish powerfully, particularly those with proven course form and fitness advantages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and allows patient tactics to unfold naturally
scenarios.body: The wall of closers led by Moon Over The Sea and Gert Lush will sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Fresh legs and proven finishing kicks will prove decisive over this stamina-sapping distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Regally Blonde fails to sustain her effort and prominent runners also fade
scenarios.body: Just Adair could capitalize from his prominent position if the pace crumbles, while any hold-up horse finding clear running will benefit. The lack of genuine pace-setters could create a messy finish favoring those closest to the action.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fitness edge prevails
scenarios.trigger: If recently raced horses show superior sharpness over those returning from long breaks
scenarios.body: Moon Over The Sea and Guinness Lad, both running within nine days, could outclass rustier rivals. Their race fitness will prove crucial in the closing stages when others tie up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from unfancied
scenarios.trigger: If market leaders underperform and an outsider finds perfect positioning
scenarios.body: Stintino Sunset or one of the returning horses could benefit from a perfectly judged ride. Light expectations and a kind draw could see an unfancied runner capitalize on others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: Moon Over The Sea could dominate if getting first run on the field given her superior recent form and fitness edge
Regally Blonde may set unsustainable fractions if pressed early by Just Adair or Dogged, compromising her stamina reserves
Guinness Lad typically races keenly and could waste energy fighting for position in the large field
Several runners returning from 200+ day breaks including Dogged, Just Adair and Lynda's Dream may need the outing
The good to firm going may catch out any horses better suited to softer conditions in this mixed-ability field

runners_data.note: Hold-up horse disappointing in four starts but now gelded and trying visor for first time
runners_data.comment: Out of the frame in four starts; gelded since last seen and a visor is now given a go
runners_data.spotlight: Out of the frame in four starts, failing to run up to market expectations on handicap debut at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) seven weeks ago; gelded since and a visor is now given a go; interesting to see if his backers return.

races.paceDynamic: We Ride At Dawn stands alone as the sole confirmed front runner in this field, giving her an uncontested lead through the early stages at Windsor's 1m2f trip. With prominent runners Kalokalo, Bennyworth, African Gib and Bosom Pals likely to settle just behind rather than press hard early, the pace will be measured and sustainable. The lack of pace pressure will allow hold-up horses like Mohaab, My Champion, Zoustellar and Thimble to get into contention from off the pace. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot late, as they'll face a sitting target up front with plenty left in the tank for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If We Ride At Dawn sets modest fractions and the prominent runners track conservatively
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the front group to sustain their kick, allowing closers to sweep past in the final two furlongs. Mohaab's recent Nottingham win came in similar tactical circumstances, while My Champion and Zoustellar have the class to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent pressure builds
scenarios.trigger: If Kalokalo and Bosom Pals decide to press We Ride At Dawn from early in the race
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates a more genuine test, suiting horses with tactical speed who can position prominently. This plays to Kalokalo's consistent record and Bosom Pals' proven ability at this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If We Ride At Dawn gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The slow pace leaves everyone else with too much to do as the leader has saved enough energy for a decisive move. Her front-running style becomes an asset rather than a liability in this weak pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the entire field goes to sleep early and it becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where recent form and natural acceleration matter most. This chaotic finish could throw up any winner from those with a turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: We Ride At Dawn could steal this if she gets completely uncontested early fractions and the field goes to sleep
Mohaab faces a 7lb rise after her Nottingham win but the good going here should still suit her style
Kalokalo's market price will indicate connections' confidence after her narrow Newbury defeat behind a subsequent winner
My Champion's headgear form since January success suggests she may struggle to recapture that level
African Gib returns from six months off for his handicap debut, making his market support crucial to assess

races.paceDynamic: Fast Steps is the clear pace angle and will likely lead uncontested from the start, with the field dominated by hold-up horses behind him. Party Island, Galaxy Wonder, Solanna and Hello Cotai will all settle in midfield or behind, creating a bunched field tracking the leader. Fast Steps should get away with moderate fractions through the middle sections before the hold-up brigade mount their challenges in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace without getting caught up in the late traffic scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Fast Steps gets soft fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run on the field and proves hard to peg back as the hold-up horses get in each other's way. His C&D experience and recent close third here make him tough to catch with tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hat-trick Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Party Island gets a clean run through
scenarios.body: The recent Bath winner gets the perfect trip tracking Fast Steps and has enough class to wear down the leader late. His excellent current form and proven ability at the trip make him the biggest threat.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Causes Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses bunch up turning in
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops with multiple runners short of room, allowing an each-way outsider with a clear run to strike. The pace becomes stop-start which suits those who can quicken late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Returning Veteran Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Grey Fox shows he retains ability after 313 days off
scenarios.body: The course specialist uses his local knowledge to find the best ground and times his run perfectly despite the long absence. His four wins here suggest the track could unlock his old ability.

watchPoints.text: Fast Steps could steal this if allowed uncontested lead as field full of hold-up horses behind him
Party Island needs clear passage late as he's proven but will be coming from well back in traffic
Grey Fox's 313-day absence is extreme even for a course specialist with four wins here previously
Magical Merlin and Saliko both try first-time cheekpieces which could spark improvement
Galaxy Wonder carries 5lb more than when narrow second to Party Island at Bath last time
